'''Air Avab''' was a floating [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the gas [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[CANTINA]] was located inside the city.
